test_title: PYST 43: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 3rd November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Six friends, namely Avik, Rishi, Piyush, Sonal, Aashu, and Rohit, are standing in a row facing north. Rishi is standing to the left of Avik and to the right of Piyush. Sonal is standing to the right of Avik and to the left of Aashu. Aashu is standing to the left of Rohit. Which two friends are standing at the centre?
solution:
Six friends, namely Avik, Rishi, Piyush, Sonal, Aashu, and Rohit, are standing in a row facing north.

1) Rishi is standing to the left of Avik and to the right of Piyush.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa52b987833f65720dddc465783bd1f70de9595391a5a3e1a7aae9c73b912f6b.png] 

2) Sonal is standing to the right of Avik and to the left of Aashu and Aashu is standing to the left of Rohit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7226f18da7aa402e37b8183870e5b10709ce66cb1db10da42a4077463c98e5b.png] 

∴ Here, In the row Avika and Sonal are sitting in centre.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Avik and Sonal".**
